observations.description: A soft neutral handbag is placed close to the skincare product as a support prop.
The support prop contributes supple matte texture and warm tonal continuity.

reference_dna.object_function: Fashion-adjacent support creates soft luxury without competing with the hero product
reference_dna.tonal_relationship: Warm low-contrast harmony around the product

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Use a restrained cognac-leather or dark-suede support surface around the perfume, preserving clear bottle dominance.
design_decision_map.rationale: The source handbag works through tactile fashion luxury and warm tonal support; a leather or suede surface preserves that function while belonging naturally to warm woody fragrance styling.

cross_category_adaptation.visual_function: Support the hero product with a soft fashion-luxury cue and controlled secondary mass.
cross_category_adaptation.material_language: Supple matte texture with warm tonal continuity and tactile richness.
cross_category_adaptation.emotional_effect: Intimate editorial sophistication, softness, and premium warmth.
cross_category_adaptation.equivalent_adaptation: Cognac leather, dark suede, or an amber-toned tactile support surface scaled beneath the perfume.
cross_category_adaptation.target_category_coherence: Leather and suede reinforce the perfume's woody amber character and established fragrance luxury codes without introducing skincare narrative.

conflicts.description: The handbag is category-native fashion support in the skincare reference but is not intrinsically meaningful beside this fragrance.
conflicts.translator_position: Preserve material sophistication and soft-luxury function while changing the literal prop.

non_negotiable_anchors.description: Warm tactile support language subordinate to the perfume hero
non_negotiable_anchors.function: Material richness, tone harmony, and premium editorial support
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: This is the transferable design intelligence behind the source prop.

flexible_areas.rationale: The future Creative Director may choose leather, suede, or another fragrance-coherent tactile equivalent.

risks.description: A literal handbag would import unrelated category narrative and make the campaign feel imitative.
risks.mitigation: Preserve tactile, tonal, and emotional functions through a fragrance-native material support.

provenance.notes: Synthetic deterministic cross-category fixture; structured rationale only.

confidence.rationale: The source prop function and target product character provide a coherent material substitution.

key_conflicts: Do not retain the handbag as a literal skincare/fashion prop.
creative_opportunities: Express woody amber character through a restrained cognac-leather or dark-suede support surface.
warnings: Keep the adapted support subordinate to bottle silhouette and label legibility.
